<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  // Function to add dnt=1 parameter to a Vimeo iframe source URL
  function addDntParameter(iframe) {
    if (
      iframe.src &&
      iframe.src.includes("://player.vimeo.com") &&
      !iframe.src.includes("dnt=1")
    ) {
      const separator = iframe.src.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
      iframe.src += separator + "dnt=1";
    }
  }

  // 1. Process existing iframes
  document.querySelectorAll("iframe").forEach(addDntParameter);

  // 2. Observe for new iframes added dynamically
  const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
      mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {

        if (node.nodeType !== 1) return; // ensure it's an element

        if (node.tagName === "IFRAME") {
          addDntParameter(node);
        } else {
          node.querySelectorAll &&
            node.querySelectorAll("iframe").forEach(addDntParameter);
        }
      });
    });
  });

  if (document.body) {
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });
  }

});
</script>



<script>
  function addDntToVimeoIframes() {
    // Select all iframe elements on the page
    const iframes = document.querySelectorAll('iframe');

    iframes.forEach(iframe => {
      // Check if the iframe source is a Vimeo URL
      if (iframe.src.includes('player.vimeo.com')) {
        const srcUrl = new URL(iframe.src);
        
        // Check if dnt is already set to avoid duplication
        if (srcUrl.searchParams.get('dnt') !== '1') {
          srcUrl.searchParams.set('dnt', '1');
          // Update the iframe's source attribute
          iframe.src = srcUrl.toString();
          console.log(`Updated Vimeo iframe src to: ${iframe.src}`);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Call the function when the page loads
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
    addDntToVimeoIframes();
  });
</script>

        this.style.setProperty('top', value, 'important');
      });
    }

    function getTopValue() {
      const ticker = document.querySelector('.navbar-ticker-banner-new');

      // presence in DOM is NOT enough — check it's actually rendered
      const inDom = !!ticker;
      const rendered = ticker ? ticker.offsetParent !== null : false;
      const tickerOpen = inDom && rendered;

      const initialTop = tickerOpen ? 490 : 65;
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      const top = Math.max(initialTop - scrollY, 56);

   

      return `${top}px`;

function loadYouTubeAPI() {
    let tag = document.createElement("script");
    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
    let firstScriptTag = document.getElementsByTagName("script")[0];
    firstScriptTag.parentNode.insertBefore(tag, firstScriptTag);
}

// YouTube API callback function
function onYouTubeIframeAPIReady() {
    player = new YT.Player("youtubePlayer", {
        events: {
            "onReady": onPlayerReady,
            "onStateChange": onPlayerStateChange
        }
    });
}

// When the player is ready, set up the observer
function onPlayerReady(event) {
    setupObserver();
}

// Save playback position every second
function onPlayerStateChange(event) {
    if (event.data == YT.PlayerState.PLAYING) {
        setInterval(() => {
            lastTime = player.getCurrentTime(); // ✅ FIXED: Directly get the value
        }, 1000);
    }
}

// Set up Intersection Observer to play/pause and resume from last position
function setupObserver() {
    let iframe = document.getElementById("youtubePlayer");

    let observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                player.seekTo(lastTime, true);
                player.playVideo();
            } else {
                player.pauseVideo();
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });

    observer.observe(iframe);
}

// Load API when the document is ready
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadYouTubeAPI);

Your original data is always available to diagnose any issues and enable reprocessing as issues are resolved.</p></div><div class="spacer-medium"></div></div><div class="dap-card-number"><div class="text-size-large">2800</div><div>data elements supported</div></div></div><div class="dap-card-info is-unify"><div class="dap-card-content"><div class="content-up"><div class="dap-card-info-title">Unify</div><div class="spacer-tiny"></div><p>Patient and provider information are aggregated into a single record containing multiple sources of information through Master Data Management functionality, including an Enterprise Master Patient Index, and data curation to remove redundancies. The data at this level is leveraged for application functionality and downstream processing.</p></div><div class="spacer-medium"></div><div class="dap-card-footer-note"><div>Unifying records at</div><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/670e4ade75003c7364a3944d/67137a28870cc6e108ac40fb_franciscan.avif" loading="lazy" width="75.5" alt="" class="image-8"></div></div><div class="dap-card-number"><div class="text-size-large">54M</div><div>patient records unified</div></div></div><div class="dap-card-info is-harmonize"><div class="dap-card-content"><div class="content-up"><div class="dap-card-info-title">Harmonize</div><div class="spacer-tiny"></div><p>The raw data is parsed and codified, then stored in a simple and clean data structure without complex relational features. The data at this level is typed and coded to the UDM’s ontology and ready to be processed into the downstream structures, which are leveraged for applications and analytics.</p></div><div class="spacer-medium"></div><div class="dap-card-footer-note"><div>Harmonizing clinical and claims data at</div><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/670e4ade75003c7364a3944d/67137a281981522775773ba0_banner-health.png" loading="lazy" width="108.5" alt="" class="image-7"></div></div><div class="dap-card-number"><div class="text-size-large">6000</div><div>data quality rules applied</div></div></div><div class="dap-card-info is-process"><div class="dap-card-content"><div class="content-up"><div class="dap-card-info-title">Process</div><div class="spacer-tiny"></div><p>Intelligent algorithms enrich the data the previous stage with deep insights. Out of the box, this includes each patient’s disposition toward quality measures (numerator, denominator, exclusions), risk and social vulnerability profiles, gaps in care, engagement data, next best actions, and more.</p></div><div class="spacer-medium"></div><div class="dap-card-footer-note"><div>Improving documentation accuracy at</div><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/670e4ade75003c7364a3944d/67137a2878d0316e46567fa3_atlantic%20health%20systems.png" loading="lazy" width="68" alt="" class="image-8"></div></div><div class="dap-card-number"><div class="text-size-large">10%</div><div>improvement in quality gap closure</div></div></div><div class="dap-card-info is-analyze"><div class="dap-card-content"><div class="content-up"><div class="dap-card-info-title">Analyze</div><div class="spacer-tiny"></div><p>Analytics summarize and denormalize the data from Unify and Process stages into a multidimensional data cube structure optimized for analytics, AI, workflows, and additional data visualization use-cases.</p></div><div class="spacer-medium"></div><div class="dap-card-footer-note"><div>Bringing analytics and AI to</div><img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/670e4ade75003c7364a3944d/67137a284ec31193b81b28df_chi-health.avif" loading="lazy" width="67" alt="" class="image-8"></div></div><div class="dap-card-number"><div class="text-size-large">22%</div><div>reduction in readmission rates</div></div></div><div class="code-embed-3 w-embed w-script"><script>
